project_type: React SPA with Vite - Video Streaming Platform (HIJISTREAM/VidStream)
build_system: Vite with npm - standard React SPA build
test_framework: Vitest (Vite-native testing) - no tests exist yet, will add basic tests
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to verify production build succeeds. 2. Run npm run dev to start dev server and verify app loads. 3. Check that all routes render correctly.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/HIJISTREAM/apps/web && npm install. 2. npm run dev to start development server.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node.js v22 available via nvm. npm/pnpm/yarn available.
contribution_requirements: Must match PRD.md and TDD.md specifications exactly. UI must be production-quality with Inter font, ghost borders, proper loading/error states. API integration with vidapi.ru.
key_patterns: React functional components with hooks, Zustand for state, React Query for data fetching, Tailwind CSS for styling, React Router DOM for routing, lucide-react for icons, localStorage for caching, iframe for video player embed
directory_structure: Monorepo structure: /apps/web/src/ contains app/ (pages), components/ (reusable UI), utils/ (api, cache, player, storage), stores/ (zustand stores). Web platform focus with React+Vite.
